meta.scene: ze155_anim, created in the open session; saved only to out/ze155_anim.blend with bpy.data.libraries.write (never over out/ze155.blend)
meta.units: metres (Blender), world axes as in BRIEF.md: +X flow, +Y operator side, Z up, screw axes at Y ±0.071, Z 1.2

ax_static.members: every render-visible object of ze155_parts / ze155_context not listed below

ax_drive_rot.replaced_by: anim_rot_* copies with origin on the motor axis (S02 only; elsewhere these groups stay visible)

ax_melt_cables.note: cables leave the top sensors; hidden whenever their sensors are cut away

ax_always_replaced.replaced_by: int_screw_*; anim_sheet, anim_curtain; split copies anim_split_band_head1/head2/scin/pumpin/pumpout/dieadapter (each joins the group of the part it clamps: head_valve, head_valve, head_valve, pump, pump, pipe); anim_split_die_bolts_top/_bottom and anim_split_die_heater_boxes_top/_bottom (split by island centre Z; top → ax_die_upper, bottom → ax_die_lower)
ax_always_replaced.note: hidden in every shot of ze155_anim

meta.visibility_rule: Only collection-level hide_render / hide_viewport of the ax_* and anim_* collections are keyed (CONSTANT). Never key or change hide_render of a ze155 object. anim-only objects (int_*, anim_*) may be keyed per object. A builder script applies STATES from this file at each shot's first frame and prints the resolved member list (prefix matches) to anim/log.md.
meta.cut_rule: Inside a section box, keep geometry where dot(p − point, normal) ≤ 0. For every member of a hidden group whose evaluated bbox centre lies inside the box: (1) if it straddles the plane → bisected copies anim_cut_<state>_<name>_keep / _rm (curves are converted to mesh first, modifiers applied, caps filled); (2) if it is fully on the keep side → an unchanged copy _keep; (3) if it is fully on the removed side → only _rm (used by the peel) or nothing. Members whose bbox centre is outside the box get an unchanged _keep copy. The _keep copies are shown in that state, so a hidden group never blanks parts that should stay.

CUT_Z_BARREL.note: feed platform and vacuum pipes hidden (I4, M7); the vents stay as ghosts plus a purple window band on the cut barrel (I5)

SEC_Z1200.desc: mặt phẳng ngang qua 2 trục vít = mặt phân khuôn; bỏ nửa trên

SEC_Y0.desc: mặt phẳng đứng giữa 2 trục vít; bỏ nửa phía người vận hành (+Y)

SEC_X2450.desc: mặt cắt ngang xi lanh B3; bỏ phía +X

SEC_X4120.desc: mặt cắt ngang qua tâm vòm chân không 2 (B5); bỏ phía +X

meta.camera_rule: loc/target in metres; target via a Track-To empty anim_tgt_<camera>; lens in mm; sensor 36 mm; clip_start 0.02 m for close-ups. Cameras bound to timeline markers at their first frame (S03 has two cameras).
meta.label_rule: Labels are drawn in post (Pillow) from per-frame 2D anchors exported from Blender with world_to_camera_view. Font Arial. Each label stays ≥ max(3 s, 0.4 s per word) = max(75, 10·words) frames; at most 4 visible at once (S15: 2); labels that start late are moved earlier so they still get their minimum; 8-frame fades. '*' marks assumed values; every shot with a '*' shows the footer '* = giả định (không có nguồn công bố)'.

rotation_rules.screws: int_screw_axis_a and _b: rotation_euler[0] = -2*pi*(screw_rpm_real/drive_slow/60)*(frame/fps). Same sign on both shafts (co-rotating). RH flights must appear to travel +X.
rotation_rules.gear_pump: top gear rotation_euler[1] positive, bottom negative (tooth gaps carry melt over the top and under the bottom, −X → +X).

render_plan.default_mcp: Render through MCP in resumable chunks: one execute_blender_code call renders ≤ 40 frames (≈ 2 min) to anim/render/frames/####.png, skipping frames whose PNG already exists, then appends 'chunk a–b done, s/frame' to anim/log.md. ≈ 130 calls. The user's Blender is busy for ≈ 3–4.5 h.
render_plan.if_Q7_approved: blender -b out/ze155_anim.blend --python anim/render_frames.py -- <start> <end>: separate background process, same skip-existing rule, can run in 2–4 chunks; test 1 frame first (EEVEE in background on macOS).
render_plan.estimate: 5275 frames × 2–3 s ≈ 2.9–4.4 h + overhead; preview 960×540 / 8 samples ≈ 0.4 s/frame ≈ 35 min.
